For the software product **Flux Image AI** at the domain **fluximageai.com**, the direct provider is operating under the entity/brand name **Flux Image AI**.

### Supporting Evidence:
* **Terms and Conditions (`fluximageai.com/terms`)**: States that the rules govern *"the use of Flux Image AI's Website, located at https://www.fluximageai.com"* and specifies that *"Unless otherwise stated, Flux Image AI and/or its licensors own the intellectual property rights for all material on Flux Image AI"*.
* **Return & Refund Policy (`fluximageai.com/refund`)**: States, *"This Return and Refund Policy ('Policy') outlines the terms and conditions for returns and refunds related to products and services provided by Flux Image AI ('we,' 'our,' or 'us')"* and notes that *"Flux Image AI provides AI-powered image generation services through a credit-based system"*.
* **Site Copyright & Contact**: The site copyright states *"© [year] Flux Image AI. All rights reserved"* and directs official inquiries to `support@fluximageai.com`. No separate parent company or individual developer is designated in its legal policies.
